commit_message: factory: verify p0 app unblock on remote runner
goal: Machine execution task. Verify the already-pushed PR branch after the P0 app/factory rollout. Do not redo broad product work. Inspect the current app/factory status, confirm the frontend contains the Фабрика Колибри title, chat-first /app route, right-bottom Control entrypoint, /api/factory/status primary path, and /cluster/status read-only fallback. If a small bug blocks verification, patch it minimally. If production deploy credentials are absent, write a blocker artifact instead of deploying. Do not cancel, requeue, drain, restart, mutate Control Plane queues, or run FormulaLM/LLM/model benchmarks on Mac.
role_goal: turn the previous failed P0 task into a completed remote factory result with self-contained verification dependencies
acceptance: Runs on fresh node main with required_capability=implementation
Does not depend on frontend/node_modules left behind by the Codex runner
Runs npm install or npm ci before lint/build verification
Verifies Фабрика Колибри is present in frontend/src/App.jsx
Verifies /api/factory/status primary path and /cluster/status fallback are present
Verifies right-bottom Control entrypoint is present
Runs frontend lint, build, and mobile layout guard
Runs Python compile checks for backend ops tests
Creates a result artifact with deploy blocker if production deploy is not authorized
Does not run FormulaLM/LLM/model benchmarks on Mac
Does not mutate Control Plane queue state

source.previous_failure: agent-host verification ran npm lint after frontend/node_modules was removed; eslint was not found
source.fix: Make verification_commands install frontend dependencies before lint/build.
